summary: Jet.AI Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a $1.75 million strategic investment in StratGrid Inc., a Calgary-based developer of natural-gas-powered data center infrastructure, made through SG Canada InvestCo LLC, a joint venture in which Jet.AI holds 60%. The investment implies InvestCo owns approximately 26% of StratGrid's fully vested common equity. The press release was issued July 29, 2026, and attached as Exhibit 99.1. This is not a transformative special situation but a minority investment disclosure. Watch for future milestones or additional funding rounds affecting Jet.AI's stake valuation.
